draft.title: Why water supply varies
card: Water supply in Australia changes a lot from place to place and from year to year. Rainfall and river flow both vary.
Climate and seasons matter. The north has a wet season and a dry season, while the south has most of its rain in the cooler months. Some years are much wetter or drier than others.
Landforms matter too. Mountains and ranges near the coast often get more rain than the flat land further inland. Most of Australia is flat and dry.
Evaporation is when water turns into vapour and rises into the air. In hot, dry places it is high, so much of the water that falls is lost from soils, dams and rivers.
draft.remember: Climate, seasons, landforms and evaporation all change how much water is available.

a.q: Which statement best explains why river flow in an inland area can drop in a hot, dry year?
opts: High evaporation removes water from rivers and soil
Rivers always flow from the coast towards the inland
Flat land makes rain fall only in the cooler months
Seasons stay the same, so river flow never changes
a.why: Hot, dry conditions cause high evaporation, so less water stays in rivers and soil. Seasons do not stay the same from year to year, so the last option is wrong.
a.clue: Think about what heat does to water lying on the surface.

b.q: Two towns in Australia get the same yearly rainfall. Town A is in a hot, dry inland area. Town B is in a cool, coastal area. Why might Town A have less water in its dam?
opts: Evaporation from Town A's dam and soil is higher
Town A is on flat land, so it gets no rain at all
Town B has no wet season, so its water never varies
Coastal areas always receive more rain than inland areas
b.why: With the same rainfall, the hotter and drier place loses more water to evaporation, so less is left in the dam. Flat land does not stop rain falling, and the question says both towns get the same rain.
b.clue: The rainfall is equal, so look at what happens to the water after it falls.

a.best: High evaporation removes water from rivers and soil

b.best: Evaporation from Town A's dam and soil is higher
